detail.desc:
*A modded character pack for Crime Boss: Rockay City.*

*Unlock Hellflower and take the city by storm with her new perks, weapons, and equipment.*

**Loadout**
- Primary Weapon: Scorp "Blossom" Elite
- Secondary Weapon: Scorp "Blossom"

**Perks**
- Blade Dancer 3
- Massacre Maiden 3
- Bullet Ballet 3

*Hellflower can be hired as a legendary team member in co-op mode and the roguelite campaign.*



**Thanks**

[Crime Boss Modding Discord](https://discord.com/channels/1067809091046613002/1233067026054910043)
[IGStudios for the Crime Boss Modkit Editor](https://store.epicgames.com/p/crime-boss--modkit?lang=en-US)
**Stardrop** from the CB modding discord
[braidy08](https://modworkshop.net/user/braidy08)
[B Dawg](https://modworkshop.net/user/bdawg)



**Issues**

- No voice

- Subdue is currently broken for Scorp Secondary

![](https://youtu.be/VkkQBpVeBKU)

![](https://youtu.be/SPlWSTkt8jI)
detail.short_desc: Hellflower offers to join the Crew. A modded character pack for Crime Boss.
detail.changelog:
**1.0.4**
+ Reduces download file size by removing unnecessary metadata with repak.exe.
+ Corrects left over formatting typo in perk description.
+ Slightly reduces perk bonuses to holster and movement speed for better balance with existing perks
+ Switches Hellflower's class perk to Merc/Hitman instead of Big Shot or Assassin to better support her aggressive playstyle.

**1.0.3**
+ Replaces arms skeletal mesh with a properly made version by Stardrop, fixing all issues with the headpiece blocking field of view in FPP.
+ Adds Hellflower boss skin appearance for the player (Julian asked).
+ Alters colors on Hellflower’s blossoms and Scorpions to fit the name better and visually distinguish them from Volk’s SMG.
+ Adds new character and weapon icons to support the texture changes.
+ Revises Hellflower’s progression screen bio with some info about the origin of her character model from a developer stream.
+ Revises perk descriptions for length and clarity.

**1.0.2**
+ Fixes issue with Hellflower’s eye material instance displaying correctly in TPP.

**1.0.1**
+ Fixes displayed dynamic translation values and strings table text for perk attribute modifiers.

detail.desc:
Sitting in the game files since release, Peak's Rifle can now finally see the light of day. All it needed was a custom first person scope setup, everything else was already done.

The mod adds it as a custom weapon (same stats as regular sniper rifle) and gives it to Peak, with working lobby pose (only for him).

Note: Due to weird rendering bugs, it does not use the sniper scope reticle, instead using one from the Vortex 3x sight found on other weapons.

detail.name: Third Person Camera
detail.desc:
**This mod is incredibly buggy, the game obviously was not made for this.**

A brand new perspective for Rockay City.

![](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jWKWU2uD6Bw)

Allows for the user to go into third person, default button to do so is T. Features a BUNCH of options for configuration, you should mess with those when you start.

BUGS:

- Certain characters may have floating/broken appendages (hair,etc). Baker and Touchdown are some for example
- Female Boss appearances have broken primary weapon animations (for some reason? Female teammembers work though)
- Quick melee does not work all the time

I hope I can fix these, but the blueprint is a fucking mess.

CONTROLS:
**Toggle Third Person - "T"
Shoulder Swap - "Z"**
detail.short_desc: Adds a third person toggle to the game.
